description: §18.17 — `@phase is .Busy` / `@phase is .Idle` over an enum with a unit and a payload variant: a `bool` in a `const`, a ternary test and an `if=`. After #go sets `.Busy(2)`, @label is "busy", #t shows "B" and #w renders.
rationale: §18.17: "`expr is .V` evaluates to `true` if and only if `expr`'s runtime value is the variant `V` of its enum type. It evaluates to `false` for all other variants. No payload is bound"; "`expression is .VariantName` SHALL have result type `boolean`"; "`is` MAY be used in: `if` conditions, … ternary expressions, … and any position where a boolean expression is valid."
